steps.h: DO NOT CHANGE CONFIGURATION UNTIL CLEAR

name: TCAS WARNING (RA)

steps.h: Vertical speed ... ADJUST or MAINTAIN (fly the green band)
CLIMB RA in CONF 3 or FULL ... GO-AROUND
FCOM: the third memory item is VERTICAL SPEED ... ADJUST or MAINTAIN; a CLIMB RA on approach in CONF 3 or FULL is GO-AROUND ... PERFORM; ATC ... NOTIFY during the RA and again when clear

name: WINDSHEAR

steps.h: After V1: “WINDSHEAR, TOGA” ... TOGA, ROTATE, FOLLOW SRS
Airborne or landing: TOGA (set or confirm) · AP (if engaged) KEEP ON · FOLLOW SRS
DO NOT CHANGE CONFIGURATION UNTIL CLEAR

FCOM: airborne or at landing the items are THR LEVERS AT TOGA ... SET OR CONFIRM, AP (if engaged) ... KEEP ON, SRS ORDERS ... FOLLOW; carefully monitor flight path and speed, recover the normal climb smoothly when out of windshear

name: OCEANIC ENGINE OUT (PRC, not a [MEM] item)
ref: PRC PRC Engine Failure During Cruise

steps.h: Pull HDG 30° away from traffic, parallel course 5 NM
PRC back page to fine tune

FCOM: the PRC says PULL SPEED - GREEN DOT initially, then ADJUST SPEED 300 kt / M0.78 for ETOPS and standard strategy (not 0.80 / 270); turn at least 30° for the 5 NM offset; PULL FL 200; START APU; declare MAYDAY
